guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：快取一致性多核心系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cache-coherent multicore systems
guides.concept: 以一致性狀態、目錄與共享粒度連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect coherence states, directories and sharing granularity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的資料、控制與時間關係。單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類單位址與雙位址測試。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「寫入擁有權」的資料、控制與時間關係。修改通常需排除其他有效副本。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤一次讀後寫入。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目錄追蹤」的資料、控制與時間關係。目錄追蹤共享者，避免總廣播。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較全位元圖與有限指標。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「真共享」的資料、控制與時間關係。填補不能消除共同資料的寫入競爭。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「區分共享鎖與分離計數器。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「協定不變量」的資料、控制與時間關係。單寫者與最新資料是不同不變量。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「對每個模擬狀態檢查兩者。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「擴展性」的資料、控制與時間關係。核心數增加可能先耗盡互連或目錄資源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分別掃描核心數與共享比例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coherence and consistency. Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify one- and two-address tests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for write ownership. Writes usually invalidate other valid copies. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace a read followed by a write. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for directory tracking. Directories track sharers to reduce broadcasts. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare full bitmaps and limited pointers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for true sharing. Padding cannot remove genuine shared-write contention. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Distinguish shared locks from separate counters. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for protocol invariants. Single-writer and latest-data are separate invariants. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check both invariants in each modeled state. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for scalability. More cores may exhaust links or directories first. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Sweep core count and sharing fraction separately. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「交通成本」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「以本課算例加上假想標頭。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「擴展性」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「核心數增加可能先耗盡互連或目錄資源。」。
提交「擴展性」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分別掃描核心數與共享比例。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit traffic costs input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit scalability two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit scalability input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：填補變數會消除所有真共享。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Padding eliminates all true sharing. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

related.title: CPU 管線與分支預測
related.why: 共用記憶體順序及停頓分析
related.transfer: 共用記憶體順序及停頓分析
related.difference: 跨核心協定需管理遠端訊息，CPU 管線主要管理本地指令
related.differenceEn: Coherence manages remote messages; pipelines manage local instructions
practice: 由「快取一致性與記憶體順序」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「跨核心協定需管理遠端訊息，CPU 管線主要管理本地指令」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From coherence and consistency, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.

For "Coherence manages remote messages; pipelines manage local instructions", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.title: 共享記憶體契約
history.text: 官方公開資料「快取一致性協定」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「快取一致性與記憶體順序」及「快取行粒度」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
